method: file-tier dead universe of one pinned corpus: every dead row of the product's deadcode family (graph wire without the symbol advisory, the core's verdict and confidence) at the pinned tip of a clean checkout, one row per file, with the measured features of features.rs - top-level node kinds through the product's parser, kept out-edges off the same graph wire, other files of the pinned tree spelling the basename (git grep -F) and the stem as a word (git grep -F -w), convention path segments, document class - and the sha256 of the text. Frozen before any audit is read and before any rule reads these features.

scope.walk: the product's own walk of the checkout (ce.toml, ignore files, built-ins)
